name: index-card
title: Index card
description: A 3 x 5 card of cream stock with a red header rule and blue lines every 30 px. Header, body and footer parts lay out on the printed rules; the card can have its rod hole punched at the foot, a colored flag stuck over its edge, and a pile of cards behind it.

a11y: An index card is a plain `div`; use `as="article"` or `role="group"` with a label when it means more. The hole, flag and pile are aria-hidden decoration; put anything a flag stands for into text.
Body ink is 14:1 on the card; the muted footer 8:1. The printed rules and the red header line are decoration and mirror for right-to-left text.
The tilt is zero in calm density; Windows high contrast replaces the drawing with a plain outline.
